reviews.text: This was a great bible app now it barely works because it it over loaded with advertisements.   Don’t even waste your time loading this one.   And they have changed many words in the King James like old sheep skins for wine making vs old bottles.  Who knows what else’s they carelessly change.  Do you know why they change words like that.  It is because they do not care for the Bible.

reviews.title: Frustrated with Inappropriate Pop-up Ads
reviews.text:
I completely understand that developers need ad revenue to keep the app running and pay the bills. However, there needs to be much better screening for the types of ads served on a holy Scripture app.
I have used this app extensively and have saved and highlighted more than half of the Bible. It feels like all that time and dedication is being undermined because almost every time I open the app, I am greeted by pop-up ads for dating apps featuring half-dressed women.
It is completely counterproductive to open a Bible app for prayer or devotion only to be immediately confronted with sexually suggestive content. Please implement stricter ad category filters so the ads align appropriately with the nature of a Bible app.

reviews.title: How to delete?
reviews.text: I have plenty of Bibles and Bible apps. This does not give me the option to delete from my iPad. Very frustrating.

reviews.title: Glitching with audio and no offline audio
reviews.text:
First of all, I would really love for the audio to work offline just like the Bible text works, it’s a NEEED!! and second for some reason there is so many glitches with the audio working or not working sometimes, when I click on a verse and then click on the audio button sometimes it gives me an option to play that verse only and if I do that, then the option to play the whole Bible ceases to exist. Or for some reason when I play the audio, it takes a really long time to start playing, and when my phone is off when I pause it for a second and then when I press play again, it takes a long time to get started again. I would say the most annoying thing about playing the audio is that when I click on the audio button, it pops up the play button and sometimes all it does is play one verse and then glitches and then doesn’t play anything, and it doesn’t give me any option to play the whole chapter anymore unless if I close out the whole app and reset it.  

WE NEED AUDIO TO BE OFFLINE AVAILABLE!!

And I’m only putting one star for this so that way I can actually get attention to this by the developers, I would actually give this app 4 stars because it’s a good app it just has one big problem that needs to be fixed.
